question: Can all local SW2014/SW2021 L2/L3 stock baskets be reconstructed causally at classification and recent cutoffs, without hidden historical anchors?
scope: Existing local stock partitions and original assignments, complete available catalog; no acquisition, labels or model tuning.
rules: EP32 float64 relative returns and float32 breadth; prior-month membership; SW2014 targets through 2021-11, SW2021 targets from 2022-01; min5 and coverage80; exact same gap/anchor rules. Slice stock/calendar at cutoff and assignments strictly before cutoff month.
comparison: Outer identity comparison vs frozen full-history daily prefixes; report missing/extra keys, compare shared values at 1e-12, never silently insert future anchors. Compare sequential reconstruction prefixes separately.
decision: Any retroactive full-history anchor is a causal-source limitation requiring explicit versioning; no patch to original research artifacts. No predictive capability claim.
